zh: 收款。SuXin POS · 收银按钮
选付款方式：现金、DuitNow QR、刷卡、电子钱包
en: Pick the payment: cash, DuitNow QR, card, e-wallet
ms: Pilih bayaran: tunai, DuitNow QR, kad, e-dompet

zh: 现金：按收到的钱，系统算找钱
en: Cash: tap what you were given; the change is worked out
ms: Tunai: tekan wang diterima; baki dikira

zh: 按完成，收据自动打印，下一单
en: Done: the receipt prints, next customer
